title: Character-Drift Detection Scorecard for AI-Illustrated Picture Books
purpose: A one-page, tool-agnostic log format for authors checking character consistency across 12–32 spreads of an AI-illustrated picture book. Closes the gap identified in art_01M6J7ARNBXAK5AWD59628F994 r1: no acceptance test or validated identity metric exists in that record set. This is an original tool, not a restatement of that record.
